validation.codeFormat: Enter the 6-digit code from the email
validation.legalNameRequired: Enter the registered name of the business
validation.gstinRequired: Enter your GSTIN, or choose Not registered for GST
validation.gstinState: This GSTIN starts with an unknown state code
validation.gstinChecksum: This GSTIN has a typo: its last character does not match
validation.gstinStateMismatch: This GSTIN belongs to a different state than the one chosen
validation.prefixInvalid: Use 1 to 5 letters, digits or hyphens
validation.prefixesSame: Invoice and credit note prefixes must be different
validation.upiInvalid: Enter a UPI ID like yourname@oksbi
validation.gstinUnsupported: Only regular GSTINs (14th character Z) are supported for now
validation.hsnInvalid: An HSN or SAC code has 4, 6 or 8 digits
validation.hsnLeadingZero: This looks like it is missing a leading zero (spreadsheets often drop it). HSN codes have 4, 6 or 8 digits, like 0401
validation.unitRequired: Choose a unit, like NOS, PCS or KGS
validation.rateRequired: Choose a GST rate, like 5 or 18
validation.skuTaken: Another product already has this SKU
validation.csvEmpty: The file has no rows to import
validation.csvTooLarge: The file is too large. Split it into files of up to 1,000 rows
validation.csvTooManyRows: A file can have at most 1,000 rows. Split it into smaller files
validation.csvColumnMissing: This column is missing. Start from the template
validation.csvUnknownColumn: This column is not in the template. Rename or remove it
validation.csvUnclosedQuote: A quote (") opened on this line is never closed
validation.csvDuplicateInFile: The same value is on an earlier row of this file
validation.csvRowInvalid: This row could not be read
validation.customerStateMismatch: This state is different from the state in the GSTIN. Tick the box below if it is right
validation.gstinTaken: Another customer already has this GSTIN
validation.creditDaysInvalid: Enter a whole number of days from 0 to 365
validation.phoneDuplicate: Another customer has this phone number. Check it is not the same person
validation.qtyInvalid: Enter a quantity like 2 or 1.5 (up to 3 decimals)
validation.discountTooLarge: Discount can't be more than the line value before tax
validation.compositionInterState: A composition business can't bill a customer in another state
validation.hsnRequired: Add the HSN/SAC code: it's required on bills to GST-registered customers
validation.recipientDetailsRequired: For bills of ₹50,000 or more to an unregistered buyer, choose a customer with name, address and state
validation.invoiceTooManyLines: An invoice can have at most 100 items
validation.dueDateBeforeInvoiceDate: The due date can't be before the invoice date
validation.placeOfSupplyInvalid: Choose a valid place of supply
validation.cancelReasonRequired: Write why the invoice is cancelled (at least 3 characters)
validation.creditReasonRequired: Write the reason for the credit note (at least 3 characters)
validation.creditLinesRequired: Enter a quantity returned for at least one item
validation.returnTooMany: More than what is left to return on this item
validation.creditExceedsBalance: The credit note is more than what is still owed on the invoice
validation.lineNotOnInvoice: This item is not on the invoice
validation.templateRequired: Write a message, or use the default
validation.templateUnknownPlaceholder: Use only the placeholders listed below
validation.templateNeedsLink: Include the invoice link placeholder, so the customer can open the invoice
validation.paymentAmountTooHigh: One payment can be at most ₹10 crore
validation.paymentDateFuture: A payment can't be dated in the future
validation.paymentDateTooOld: A payment can be dated at most one year back
validation.allocationTooMany: Apply the payment to at most 100 invoices
validation.allocationAmountPositive: Enter an amount above zero, or leave this invoice out
validation.allocationExceedsBalance: More than is due on this invoice
validation.allocationExceedsPayment: The amounts add up to more than the payment
validation.invoiceNotOpen: Nothing is due on this invoice any more
validation.walkInPaymentInvalid: A walk-in sale is paid only on its own invoice, up to its balance
validation.voidReasonRequired: Say why this payment is voided
validation.openingBalanceApplied: Payments already settled more of the opening balance than this. Void them first.
validation.refundExceedsOnAccount: That's more than the customer has on account.
validation.refundModeRequired: Choose how the money was given back.
validation.rangeReversed: The start date is after the end date.
validation.rangeTooLong: Choose a period of at most 366 days.
